findings.claim: No mech can live to the 8:00 HP tiebreak with default config: the last circle closes to radius 0 by about 6:55 (415 s), and from then on everyone takes 260 HP/s with no armor and no regen. Even 1400 HP x 1.4 (10 cubes) x 1.15^3 (3 platings), about 2,980 HP, lasts about 11.5 s. So HYP-011's 'survivors at 8:00 ranked by HP' never applies. The real endgame rule: the order of death in the 6:55 collapse is the order of HP at that moment (same-tick deaths share a place).

sources.quote: The last circle closes by about 6:55. Matches end when one mech is left or at 8:00

sources.ref: mechfight-kit/check/stream.jsonl.gz hello.config.zone.phases (hold+shrink sum 415 s; last dps 260) and config.match.duration_s 480

sources.quote: If the clock runs out, survivors are ranked by HP.
Survivors at 8:00 ranked by HP; zone damage ignores armor

findings.suggested_change: Restate HYP-011 as 'enter the 6:55 collapse with the most HP'. If it is ever built: from about 6:30 (zone radius <= 25 m), with HP under max and no enemy hitting us, stop firing so the 5 s regen delay runs, and stand at the circle center to regenerate at 45 HP/s. Plating (+15% max HP) helps in the collapse and armor does not, since zone damage ignores armor. Low priority: at 3.50 we usually die well before 6:30.
findings.mechanism: In the collapse each 260 HP of extra health is about 1 s more of life, which can be a place or more among the last mechs. It matters only in matches we reach the end of, so the gain is small until survival improves.

failure_classes.basis: endgame collapse arithmetic from config; frequency of reaching 6:30 unknown
